title: Formatting: marks, headings, lists, input rules
goal: Bold/italic marks and paragraph/H1–H3/bullet-list block types via shortcuts and markdown-style input rules, with ProseMirror-like structural behaviour.
scope: Mod+B / Mod+I via formatBold/formatItalic or keydown fallback; formatRemove
Stored marks at a collapsed caret (toggle, then type); caret movement clears them
Input rules at block start: "# ", "## ", "### " → heading; "- " / "* " → list item; undo restores the literal text
Block-type shortcuts as in the ProseMirror example keymap (scout extracts the exact keys)
Enter at end of heading → paragraph; Enter on empty list item → paragraph; Backspace at start of list item → paragraph
out_of_scope: Ordered and nested lists, links, other marks

rules.rule: The bar is behaviour: no ProseMirror code is copied.

bar.primary: B2 ProseMirror basic example (structure + marks per step)

criteria: Structural corpus (≥ 40 scenarios): block types, text and marks equal ProseMirror per target, or each divergence judged blind in our favour.
Fuzz with formatting weights: I1–I8 hold on all targets.
The ghost exposes headings and lists correctly (a11y snapshot).
Stored marks: Mod+B then typing yields bold text; moving the caret clears the stored mark.
